metadata.question: Did smoke from the Lynx Mountain fire in northeastern Washington spread into British Columbia on September 13, 2025?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need to detect smoke from a fire in northeastern Washington on September 13, 2025 - Smoke can be detected using aerosol optical depth (AOD) or visible imagery from satellites - Sentinel-5P TROPOMI has aerosol products - Could also use MODIS or VIIRS for visual smoke detection - Will use Sentinel-5P aerosol index and/or MODIS/VIIRS imagery 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed - we want to see smoke/aerosols - Will look at aerosol optical depth or aerosol index values - Compare areas in northeastern Washington vs British Columbia border 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - If no satellite data available for Sept 13, 2025 → C1 - If data exists but processing fails → C3 - If elevated aerosols/smoke visible in BC → A - If no smoke spread detected → B Note: September 2025 is in the future from my training data. I'll code assuming the data might exist or treating this as a hypothetical scenario that requires checking if data exists. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { try { // Define northeastern Washington (Lynx Mountain area) and BC border region const lynxMountain = ee.Geometry.Point([-117.48, 48.85]); // Approximate location const bcBorder = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-118.5, 49.0], [-116.5, 49.0], [-116.5, 49.5], [-118.5, 49.5], [-118.5, 49.0]] ]); const washingtonArea = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-118.5, 48.5], [-116.5, 48.5], [-116.5, 49.0], [-118.5, 49.0], [-118.5, 48.5]] ]); const date = '2025-09-13'; // Try MODIS Terra/Aqua for smoke detection const modisCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD09GA') .filterDate(date, '2025-09-14') .filterBounds(lynxMountain); console.log('MODIS images found:', modisCol.size().getInfo()); if (modisCol.size().getInfo() === 0) { // Try VIIRS const viirsCol = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP09GA') .filterDate(date, '2025-09-14') .filterBounds(lynxMountain); console.log('VIIRS images found:', viirsCol.size().getInfo()); if (viirsCol.size().getInfo() === 0) { console.log('No satellite imagery available for September 13, 2025'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // Try Sentinel-5P aerosol index const s5pCol = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_AER_AI') .filterDate(date, '2025-09-14') .filterBounds(bcBorder); console.log('Sentinel-5P aerosol images:', s5pCol.size().getInfo()); if (s5pCol.size().getInfo() === 0) { console.log('No aerosol data available for this date'); console.log('C1'); return; } const aerosolImg = s5pCol.mean(); // Check aerosol index in Washington (source) const washStats = aerosolImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: washingtonArea, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const washMean = washStats.get('absorbing_aerosol_index_mean').getInfo(); const washCount = washStats.get('absorbing_aerosol_index_count').getInfo(); console.log('Washington AOI - Mean aerosol index:', washMean, 'Pixels:', washCount); if (washCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels in Washington area'); console.log('C2'); return; } // Check aerosol index in BC (receptor) const bcStats = aerosolImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: bcBorder, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const bcMean = bcStats.get('absorbing_aerosol_index_mean').getInfo(); const bcCount = bcStats.get('absorbing_aerosol_index_count').getInfo(); console.log('BC border - Mean aerosol index:', bcMean, 'Pixels:', bcCount); if (bcMean === null || washMean === null) { console.log('Calculation failed - null results'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Elevated aerosol index (>1.5) suggests smoke presence if (bcMean > 1.5 && washMean > 1.5) { console.log('Elevated aerosols detected in both regions - smoke spread into BC'); console.log('A'); } else if (bcMean > 1.0 && washMean > 1.5) { console.log('Moderate aerosols in BC with elevated levels in Washington'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('No significant smoke spread detected into BC'); console.log('B'); } } catch (error) { console.log('Error:', error.message); console.log('D'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
